audit_context: This repeat build verified the exact pre-guard R197 source. Static audit then found the Host entry accepted widths above the source's documented maximum of 32768, allowing an FP32 wide partial destination to exceed its per-row reduction allocation at width 32769. A width guard was added in a follow-up safety commit; this artifact does not include that guard.
